newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK PARLIAMENT PASSES BILL ON PRIVACY, LIBERTIES-ANA.
newsitem.headline: GREEK PARLIAMENT PASSES BILL ON PRIVACY, LIBERTIES-ANA.

text.p: The Greek parliament passed a bill on protecting privacy and individual liberties, a condition for Greece's participation in the Schengen agreement, said the state news agency ANA.
The parliament passed the bill in principle with 132 voting for and 89 voting against, it said.
Greece is one of the few EU member states that have not ratified the agreement yet, it added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
